candidates.doc:
DrawCardWithEvent draws a card for a player and fires the draw event.

Rule 616/614.16-ish ([VOCAB] #1291): before drawing, checks for an active
draw-replacement effect (e.g. "if you would draw a card, you may instead
search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle" —
installed via cardfns.GrantDrawReplacement/ReplaceDrawWithLibrarySearch).
If one applies, its substituted action runs INSTEAD of the draw: the card
is never drawn from the library the normal way, and no draw event/trigger
fires below, since a draw never actually happened. This is distinct from a
triggered "whenever you draw a card" reaction, which exists alongside the
real draw rather than replacing it.
candidates.name: DrawCardWithEvent
candidates.title: DrawCardWithEvent

candidates.description: // ReplaceDrawWithLibrarySearch installs a draw-replacement (see
candidates.doc:
ReplaceDrawWithLibrarySearch installs a draw-replacement (see
GrantDrawReplacement) modelling "if you would draw a card, you may instead
search your library for a [filter] card, put that card into your hand,
then shuffle" ([VOCAB] #1291). filter selects which library cards qualify
(nil matches any card). Honors active search-restriction effects (e.g.
Aven Mindcensor) via the same searchableLibrary helper the SearchLibrary*
tutor family uses.

The engine's non-interactive auto-resolve convention always takes the
beneficial replacement (auto-"yes" on the "may instead," matching every
other may-effect in this codebase) and auto-selects the first qualifying
card in library order (the SearchLibrary* family's convention for "search
... choose" without player interaction).

If no card matches filter, the library is still shuffled (the search still
happened, it just found nothing) and no card is put into hand — the
engine's draw-replacement substitutes for the draw either way, so the
player draws nothing that turn unless replacement/filter is composed with
an explicit fallback.
candidates.name: ReplaceDrawWithLibrarySearch
candidates.signature: func ReplaceDrawWithLibrarySearch(gs *game.GameState, self *game.Card, playerIdx int, filter func(*game.Card) bool) *game.ReplacementEffect
candidates.title: ReplaceDrawWithLibrarySearch

candidates.doc:
grantedNestedActivatedAbilities synthesizes one *ActivatedAbility per
active nested-activated grant whose Recipients currently matches card --
live-recomputed exactly like grantedFilteredActivatedAbilities (a late
entrant picks the ability up on its very next GetCardAbilities call, the
grant dies the instant Source leaves the battlefield, no separate revoke).

candidates.description: encoreActivatedAbilities synthesizes the intrinsic Encore ability for a
candidates.doc:
encoreActivatedAbilities synthesizes the intrinsic Encore ability for a
card with a printed EncoreCost — but only while the card is actually
sitting in its owner's graveyard, mirroring how
grantedGraveyardActivatedAbilities gates granted abilities on live
graveyard membership. Returns nil in every other zone, so battlefield/
hand ability indices never shift.
candidates.name: encoreActivatedAbilities
candidates.title: encoreActivatedAbilities
